ecr.title: Fiber Array Unit KVP-FAU-2408 - change Rev B to Rev C (0° in-air end face with AR coating for micro-lens coupling, core position ± 0.5 µm, 500 mm pigtail, +1,000 pcs)
ecr.reason: Kalvara changed the engine coupling concept from index-matched butt coupling to free-space coupling through a wafer-level micro-lens array: the FAU end face now works in air at 0.25 mm from the lens array and is placed passively to fiducials. This needs a flat (0°) AR-coated end face and a tighter absolute core position. The new engine layout shortens the fibre route. Forecast increased.

changes.title: End face 8° APC (index-matched) -> 0° flat, AR coated, used in air
changes.to: 0.0° ± 0.3°, AR coating R ≤ 0.1 % at 1260-1360 nm, in air, RL ≥ 30 dB
changes.reason: Free-space coupling through the micro-lens array
changes.lpc: Feasible - 0° array fixtures available (LPC-QM-021 §3). In air the end face is optically active: recess / protrusion ± 0.3 µm and flatness ≤ 0.5 µm with 100 % interferometry and a repolish loop (LPC-LL-003 DR-09). AR coating by SUB-251 in batches of up to 150 pcs, +10 working days per batch; arrays pre-baked 2 h at 85 °C before coating (epoxy outgassing). Not requested by Kalvara but required: the RL of the 0° coated face is ≥ 30 dB instead of ≥ 60 dB - Kalvara to confirm that the ELS lasers tolerate this back-reflection (isolator in the ELS module).
changes.cost: Approx. + USD 6 per pc full cost (AR coating, pre-bake, interferometry, in-air RL test); NRE USD 8,500
changes.schedule: AR coating adds 2 weeks to every lot
changes.decision: Accepted - Kalvara confirmed ELS isolation ≥ 25 dB
changes.zone: Sh1 D5, E1 / Sh2 A1, B3, D1, E1, E3, F4 / Sh3 B5
